flow = @chain CSV.read(
    joinpath(DIR_PRJ, "data", "flow.tsv"),
    DataFrame
    ) begin
    @inner_join(
        @chain naics2ipa begin
            @select(account, aggregate)
            @distinct
        end
    )
    @group_by(aggregate, year)
    @summarize(
        gfcf = sum(gfcf) / 1_000,
        volume = sum(volume) / 1_000
    )
    @ungroup
    @rename(account = aggregate)
end

plt_lvl = data(
    @chain flow begin
        @select(
            account, year, value = gfcf
    #     @group_by(year)
    #     @summarize(value = sum(value))
        )
    end
    ) *
    mapping(
        :year => "",
        :value => "Billions of current dollars",
        color = :account => renamer(
            naics_renamer
        ) => "",
        stack = :account => "",
    ) *
    visual(BarPlot)
plt_growth = data(
    begin
        x = @chain flow begin
            @group_by(year)
            @summarize(value = sum(gfcf))
        end
        x[!, :growth] = vcat(missing, diff(log.(x[!, :value])))
        x
    end
    ) *
    mapping(
        :year => "",
        :growth => (x -> 100x) => "Growth (%)",
    ) *
    visual(
        BarPlot,
        color = RGBAf(0, 0, 0, 0.25)
    )
fig = Figure(
    fonts = (;
        regular = "Dejavu",
        weird = "Blackchancery"
    )
)
gridpos = fig[1:2, :]
f = draw!(
    gridpos,
    plt_lvl,
    scales(
        Color = (;
            palette = CAT22
        )
    ),
    axis = (;
        xticks = 1997:2:2024,
        yticks = 0:100:1_200,
        xticklabelrotation = π / 4,
        limits = (1996.5, 2024.5, 0, 1_200),
    ),
)
legend!(
    gridpos,
    f;
    orientation = :horizontal,
    tellwidth = false,
    halign = :left,
    valign = :top,
    nbanks = 4,
    labelsize = 8,
    colgap = 5
)
gridpos = fig[3, :]
f2 = draw!(
    gridpos,
    plt_growth,
    axis = (;
        xticks = 1998:2:2024,
        yticks = -10:5:20,
        limits = (1997.5, 2024.5, -5, 15),
        xticklabelrotation = π / 4,
    ),
)

netstock = @chain CSV.read(
    joinpath(DIR_PRJ, "data", "stock.tsv"),
    DataFrame
    ) begin
    @inner_join(
        @chain naics2ipa begin
            @select(account, aggregate)
            @distinct
        end
    )
    @group_by(aggregate, year)
    @summarize(
        volume = sum(volume) / 1_000,
        netstock = sum(netstock) / 1_000,
        current_cost_netstock = sum(current_cost_netstock) / 1_000,
        cfc = sum(cfc) / 1_000
    )
    @ungroup
    @rename(account = aggregate)
    @select(
        account,
        year,
        netstock,
        current_cost_netstock,
        cfc
    )
    @filter((year - ~minimum(year)) ≥ 5)
end

gdp = @chain readtable(
    joinpath(DIR_PRJ, "data", "bea", "ValueAdded.xlsx"),
    "TVA105-A",
    "A:AE",
    first_row = 8
) begin
    DataFrame
    first
    @pivot_longer(Cols(contains(r"^\d{4}$")))
    @select(variable, value)
    @arrange
    @select(
        year = as_integer(variable),
        gdp = as_integer(value) / 1_000
    )
    @inner_join(
        @chain netstock begin
            @filter(account == "G")
            @select(year, cfc)
        end
    )
    @inner_join(
        @chain flow begin
            @inner_join(netstock)
            @group_by(year)
            @summarize(
                value = sum(
                    case_when(
                        account == "G" => cfc,
                        true => gfcf
                    )
                )
            )
        end
    )
    @select(
        year,
        share = value / (gdp + cfc)
    )
end

vaxind = @chain readtable(
    joinpath(DIR_PRJ, "data", "bea", "ValueAdded.xlsx"),
    "TVA105-A",
    "A:AE", # Till 2024
    first_row = 8
    ) begin
    DataFrame
    rename("#Empty" => "title")
    @select(Cols("title", r"\d{4}"))
    @mutate(title = strip(title))
    @inner_join(ipa_key)
    @select(Cols("account", r"\d{4}"))
    @pivot_longer(
        cols = Not(:account),
        names_to = year,
        values_to = va
    )
    @select(
        account = as_string(account),
        year = as_integer(year),
        va = as_integer(va)
    )
    @group_by(year, account)
    @summarize(va = sum(va))
    @ungroup
end

cfc_shares = @chain flow begin
    @inner_join(netstock)
    @mutate(
        α = case_when(
            true => cfc
        ),
        va_adjustment = case_when(
            account == "G" => cfc,
            true => gfcf
        ),
    )
    @group_by(year)
    @summarize(
        va_adjustment = sum(va_adjustment),
        α = sum(α)
    )
    @select(
        account = "GDP",
        year,
        va_adjustment,
        α
    )
    @bind_rows(
        @chain flow begin
            @filter(account ≠ "G")
            @inner_join(netstock)
            @group_by(year)
            @summarize(
                account = "PVT",
                α = sum(cfc),
                va_adjustment = sum(gfcf)
            )
        end
    )
    @bind_rows(
        @chain flow begin
            @inner_join(netstock)
            @select(
                account,
                year,
                α = case_when(
                    true => cfc
                ),
                va_adjustment = case_when(
                    account == "G" => cfc,
                    true => gfcf
                )
            )
        end
    )
    @inner_join(vaxind)
    @select(
        account,
        year,
        va = va + 1_000va_adjustment,
        α
    )
    @mutate(share = 1_000α / va)
    @select(-α)
end

function obtain_prices(tbl)
    prices = @chain tbl begin
        @select(year, price)
        @arrange
        @mutate(x = case_when(
            year == 2017 => 1.0,
            true => missing
            )
        )
    end
    for i in range(
        findfirst(isequal(2018), prices[!, :year]),
        nrow(prices)
        )
        prices[i, :x] =
            prices[i - 1, :x] *
            exp(prices.price[i])
    end
    for i in collect(range(
        findfirst(isequal(2016), prices[!, :year]),
        1,
        step = -1
        ))
        prices[i, :x] =
            prices[i + 1, :x] /
            exp(prices.price[i + 1])
    end
    output = @chain prices begin
        @select(year, price = x)
        dropmissing!
    end
end

ind_shares = @chain flow begin
    @inner_join(netstock)
    @mutate(
        α = case_when(
            account == "G" => cfc,
            true => gfcf
        ),
        va_adjustment = case_when(
            account == "G" => cfc,
            true => gfcf
        ),
    )
    @group_by(year)
    @summarize(
        va_adjustment = sum(va_adjustment),
        α = sum(α)
    )
    @select(
        account = "GDP",
        year,
        va_adjustment,
        α
    )
    @bind_rows(
        @chain flow begin
            @filter(account ≠ "G")
            @group_by(year)
            @summarize(
                account = "PVT",
                α = sum(gfcf),
                va_adjustment = sum(gfcf)
            )
        end
    )
    @bind_rows(
        @chain flow begin
            @left_join(netstock)
            @select(
                account,
                year,
                α = case_when(
                    account == "G" => cfc,
                    true => gfcf
                ),
                va_adjustment = case_when(
                    account == "G" => cfc,
                    true => gfcf
                )
            )
            @arrange(account, year)
            dropmissing!
        end
    )
    @inner_join(vaxind)
    @select(
        account,
        year,
        va = va + 1_000va_adjustment,
        α
    )
    @mutate(share = 1_000α / va)
    @select(-α)
end

growth_va = @chain ind_shares begin
    @inner_join(vaxind_fpi)
    @left_join(prices)
    @arrange
    @group_by(account)
    combine(_) do subdf
        @chain subdf begin
            @select(
                account, year,
                va,
                fpi = fpi / lag(fpi),
                price = price / lag(price),
                share = (share + lag(share)) / 2
            )
            transform!(
                [:fpi, :price] .=> ByRow(log),
                renamecols = false
            )
        end
    end
    #= Now to get the new prices =#
    @select(
        account, year,
        price = share * price + (1 - share) * fpi
    )
    @arrange
    @group_by(account)
    combine(obtain_prices)
    @rename(FPI = price)
    @inner_join(
        @chain ind_shares begin
            @select(
                account,
                year,
                va
            )
        end
    )
    @select(
        account,
        year,
        VA = va / FPI
    )
    #= This can be toggle to explore the annualized GDP growth with data from 2008-2022.
    @filter(account == "GDP")
    @filter(year ∈ [2008, 2022])
    end
    100((growth_va[!, :VA][end] / growth_va[!, :VA][1])^inv(only(diff(growth_va[!, :year])))-1)
    =#
    @group_by(account)
    @summarize(
        year,
        adj_growth = Main.log(VA / lag(VA))
    )
    dropmissing!
    @inner_join(vaxind_fqi)
    # @filter(
        # (account ∉ ["GDP", "G"]) | (year ≥ (minimum(year) + 5))
    # ) # To account for initial seed for CFC.
    @group_by(account)
    combine(_) do subdf
        avg_pub = mean(subdf[!,:published_growth])
        avg_adj = mean(subdf[!,:adj_growth])
        cum_pub = sum(
            subdf[!,:published_growth]
        )
        cum_adj = sum(
            subdf[!,:adj_growth]
        )
        (;avg_pub, avg_adj, cum_pub, cum_adj)
    end
    @mutate(
        avg_Δ = avg_adj - avg_pub,
        cum_Δ = cum_adj - cum_pub
    )
    @select(
        account,
        avg_adj = round(100avg_adj, digits = 2),
        avg_pub = round(100avg_pub, digits = 2),
        avg_Δ = round(100avg_Δ, digits = 2),
        cum_adj = round(100cum_adj, digits = 2),
        cum_pub = round(100cum_pub, digits = 2),
        cum_Δ = round(100cum_Δ, digits = 2)
    )
end

nominal_sector = @chain flow begin
    @mutate(sector = case_when(
        account == "G" => "Public",
        true => "Private"
        )
    )
    @group_by(year, sector)
    @summarize(gfcf = sum(gfcf))
    @ungroup
    @inner_join(
        x = @chain fixed_assets_series begin
            @filter(MetricName == "Historical Cost")
            rename("%SeriesCode" => "series_code")
            @select(
                year = Period,
                nominal = Value / 1_000,
                variable = case_when(
                    endswith(series_code, r"es(00|nr)") => "NR/FA",
                    endswith(series_code, "ip00") => "IPP"
                ),
                sector = case_when(
                    SubString(series_code, 3, 3) == "g" => "Public",
                    SubString(series_code, 3, 3) == "n" => "Private"
                ),
            )
        end
    )
    @mutate(share = gfcf / (nominal + gfcf))
end

        # "i3gtotl1eq00", # GNE
        # "i3gtotl1stnr", # GNS
        "i3gtotl1ens0", # GS
        "i3gtotl1rd00", # GR&D
        ]
    )
    @filter(Period ∈ 1997:2024)
    @inner_join(fixed_assets_series_meta)
    @mutate(Value = as_float(replace(Value, ',' => "")))
    @select(
        SeriesLabel = case_when(
            SeriesLabel == "Entertainment, literary, and artistic originals" => "ELAO",
            SeriesLabel == "Research and development" => "R&D",
            true => SeriesLabel
        ),
        sector = case_when(
            SubString(`%SeriesCode`, 3, 3) == "n" => "Private",
            SubString(`%SeriesCode`, 3, 3) == "g" => "Government"
        ),
        year = Period,
        Value
    )
    @bind_rows(
        @chain flow begin
            @mutate(
                sector = case_when(
                    account ≠ "G" => "Private",
                    account == "G" => "Government"
                )
            )
            @group_by(year, sector)
            @summarize(Value = 1_000sum(gfcf))
            @ungroup
            @mutate(SeriesLabel = "DD")
        end
    )
    @filter(
        SeriesLabel ∈ ["R&D", "Software", "DD", "ELAO"]
    )
end

end

Growth FA

growth_gfcf = @chain nominal_sector begin
    @inner_join(
        x = @chain national_series begin
            @filter(MetricName == "Fisher Price Index")
            rename!("%SeriesCode" => "series_code")
            @select(
                year = Period,
                fpi = Value,
                variable = case_when(
                    contains(SeriesLabel, "Intellectual property products") => "IPP",
                    SeriesLabel ∈ [
                        "Gross government fixed investment",
                        "Nonresidential"
                        ] => "NR/FA",
                    true => missing
                ),
                sector = case_when(
                    contains(`TableId:LineNo`, "T50904") => "Public",
                    contains(`TableId:LineNo`, "T50304") => "Private",
                    true => missing
                ),
            )
        end
    )
    @left_join(prices)
    @arrange
    @group_by(sector, variable)
    combine(_) do subdf
        @chain subdf begin
            @mutate(Laspeyres_share = lag(share))
            rename("share" => "Paasche_share")
            @select(
                sector, variable, year,
                fpi = Main.log(fpi / lag(fpi)),
                price = Main.log(price / lag(price)),
                Laspeyres_share, Paasche_share,
            )
        end
    end
    @mutate(
        Laspeyres = Laspeyres_share * price + (1 - Laspeyres_share) * fpi,
        Paasche = Paasche_share * price + (1 - Paasche_share) * fpi,
    )
    #= Now to get the new prices =#
    @select(
        sector, variable, year,
        price = (Laspeyres + Paasche) / 2
    )
    @arrange
    @group_by(sector, variable)
    combine(obtain_prices)
    @ungroup
    @inner_join(
        @chain nominal_sector begin
            @select(
                sector, variable, year,
                Nominal = (nominal + gfcf)
            )
        end
    )
    @mutate(volume = Nominal / price)
    @arrange
    @group_by(sector, variable)
    @summarize(
        year = year,
        volume = Main.log(volume / lag(volume))
    )
    @ungroup
    dropmissing!
    @inner_join(
        x = @chain fixed_assets_series begin
            @filter(MetricName == "Fisher Quantity Index")
            rename("%SeriesCode" => "series_code")
            @select(
                year = Period,
                fqi = Value,
                variable = case_when(
                    endswith(series_code, r"es(00|nr)") => "NR/FA",
                    endswith(series_code, "ip00") => "IPP"
                ),
                sector = case_when(
                    SubString(series_code, 3, 3) == "g" => "Public",
                    SubString(series_code, 3, 3) == "n" => "Private"
                ),
            )
            @arrange
            @group_by(sector, variable)
            @summarize(
                year,
                fqi = Main.log(fqi / lag(fqi))
            )
            @ungroup
            dropmissing!
        end
    )
    rename!(
        :volume => :adj_growth,
        :fqi => :published_growth
    )
    @mutate(Δ_growth = adj_growth - published_growth)
    @group_by(sector, variable)
    combine(_) do subdf
        avg_pub = mean(subdf[!,:published_growth])
        avg_adj = mean(subdf[!,:adj_growth])
        cum_pub = sum(
            subdf[!,:published_growth]
        )
        cum_adj = sum(
            subdf[!,:adj_growth]
        )
        (;avg_pub, avg_adj, cum_pub, cum_adj)
    end
    @mutate(
        avg_Δ = avg_adj - avg_pub,
        cum_Δ = cum_adj - cum_pub
    )
    @select(
        sector,
        variable,
        avg_adj = round(100avg_adj, digits = 2),
        avg_pub = round(100avg_pub, digits = 2),
        avg_Δ = round(100avg_Δ, digits = 2),
        cum_adj = round(100cum_adj, digits = 2),
        cum_pub = round(100cum_pub, digits = 2),
        cum_Δ = round(100cum_Δ, digits = 2)
    )
end

share_stock = @chain netstock begin
    # @filter(year ≥ 2008)
    @mutate(sector = case_when(
        account == "G" => "Public",
        true => "Private"
        )
    )
    @group_by(sector, year)
    @summarize(ns = 1_000sum(current_cost_netstock))
    @ungroup
    @inner_join(
        x = @chain fixed_assets_series_stock begin
            @filter(MetricName == "Current Dollars")
            rename("%SeriesCode" => "series_code")
            @select(
                year = Period,
                stock = Value,
                variable = case_when(
                    endswith(series_code, r"es(00|nr)") => "NR/FA",
                    endswith(series_code, "ip00") => "IPP"
                ),
                sector = case_when(
                    SubString(series_code, 3, 3) == "g" => "Public",
                    SubString(series_code, 3, 3) == "n" => "Private"
                ),
            )
        end
    )
    @mutate(
        share = ns / (stock + ns),
    )
    # @filter((year - ~minimum(year)) ≥ 5)
end

plt = data(
    begin
    x = @chain share_stock begin
        @filter(sector == "Public")
        @filter(variable == "IPP")
        @select(
            year,
            value = 100share
        )
    end
    end
    ) *
    mapping(
        :year => "",
        :value => "Share (%)",
    ) *
    visual(BarPlot, color = RGBAf(0, 0, 0, 0.25))

)
